title: Engaging with the EMSL 1000 Fungal Protein Project
content: Fungi represent the largest, most diverse group of microorganisms on Earth. With an estimated 1.5 million species, fungi live everywhere from soil to air and in plants, animals, and the human body. In recent years, the catalog of fungal genome sequences in public databases has grown rapidly. However, functional and structural characterization of the proteins encoded in these sequences has not kept the same pace.
